title: Ordinary scalar tensor chain comparisons respect associators
statement: For finite coefficient fields E,L,F over Q_l with maps iota:E→L and j:L→F, every scheme W and arbitrary cochain complexes P,Q, the normalized ordinary total tensor comparison [lem-weil-normalized-ordinary-scalar-tensor-chain] obeys S_j(mu_iota(P,Q));mu_j(S_iota P,S_iota Q);Tot_F(kappa_P,kappa_Q)=kappa_(Tot_E(P,Q));mu_(j iota)(P,Q), with kappa the termwise scalar associator [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition].

source.place: Tensor reassociation, evaluation and coefficient comparisons; scalar-comparison proof step 9 of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08J9 and 08TC.

proof.text: In each total degree apply the composite extension/restriction adjunction, whose Hom equivalence is injective. Test the adjoint maps on the pure bidegree tensor generators. Naturality of scalar extension sends a unit tensor through the first comparison. Its normalization and the second comparison normalization reduce the successive route to a tensor of two nested unit scalar generators. The normalized scalar associator sends each nested generator to the direct unit scalar generator, and does the same for the original total tensor generator. The direct comparison normalization gives the same output. Total tensor generation proves equality in each degree, hence equality of chain maps.

theorem integralScalarOrdinaryTensorChainTower (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    ((integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (((normalizedIntegralOrdinaryTensorChain l E L ι W).exists.choose).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      ((normalizedIntegralOrdinaryTensorChain l L F j W).exists.choose).hom.app
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P,
          ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l F W)).map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q)) =
    (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
      (.up ℤ)).hom.app
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)) ≫
      ((normalizedIntegralOrdinaryTensorChain l E F (j.comp ι) W).exists.choose).hom.app
        (P, Q)
